notes: Iteration 1 run 2026-08-20. Baseline arm is a subagent with NO skill - which is approximately the few-sentence prompt that produced the existing eleven-artifact corpus, so this suite is the null hypothesis for whether the skill should exist.
The with-skill arm is given the skill PATH, not an activated slash command, so it does not require the skill to be in the session's registry.

Case 2 is cheap and tests a guard rather than an artifact: a bare PR number must be refused, because it resolves against the current directory's git remote and would silently describe a different pull request in another worktree.

Case 3 added after iteration 1, which had a coverage hole: BOTH its fixtures happened to have no bead in frontmatter, so the suite tested declaring an absent bead and never tested a successful harvest - the one path whose value the eval called into question.

Eval prompts MUST forbid writes outside the run's own outputs directory. Iteration 1 subagents filed five beads to the tracker (ivpr, p3pe, cqi6, hgxm, i3ei). All agent-proposed and deferred so harmless, but an eval that mutates shared state is not a clean measurement.

Word ratio and words per visual are RECORDED per run with the references/craft.md scripts, for comparison across iterations. No assertion passes or fails on them: a reader could not follow a band-compliant explainer, and the version they could follow was 94% of its source at 342 words per visual.
Bead fixtures are NOT committed - see evals/fixtures/README.md. Regenerate with `bd show <id> --json`. They carry named individuals and local paths.

assertions_apply_to_all_cases.assertion: Output is exactly one HTML file containing zero tags, zero external
Every acronym and project-specific term is expanded on first use in the 'full name (ACRONYM)' form. This is the measured gap the skill exists to close - only 2 of 11 existing artifacts do it.
assertions_apply_to_all_cases.check: manual read; sample five acronyms from the source and confirm each is expanded at its first occurrence in the output

assertions_apply_to_all_cases.assertion: A provenance block names every harvest source attempted and, for each that found nothing, the exact lookup that failed. Absence of context must be distinguishable from context that existed and was missed.
assertions_apply_to_all_cases.check: output contains a provenance section listing all five Step 2 sources, each with a result

assertions_apply_to_all_cases.assertion: A footer carries the path to the full source document, a commit SHA, and the generation timestamp, so staleness is visible on inspection.
